CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  August 18, 2025

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Chen, Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Maia McCurley, Planning Manager; Megan Wu, Senior Planner; Avery
  Tao, Assistant Planner; Karabeth Garcia, Executive Assistant; Erica
  Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA

  submitted the Minutes of the July 21, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner
  Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-1-0

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS

  •  There were no discussion items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-24-02
  •  3071 West Valley Boulevard
  •  Applicant: Juan Duran
  •  This is an application for a Conditional Use Permit CUP-24-02 to
  legalize Phoenix Auto Care’s expanded business operations into
  an unpermitted 206 square foot addition to an existing one-story
  automotive repair shop, on a site of approximately 9,588 square

  2
  08/18/2025
   feet, located at 3071 West Valley Boulevard in the CMU
  (Commercial Mixed-Use) zone.
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 25-05, approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-24-02 to legalize Phoenix Auto
  Care’s expanded business operations into an unpermitted 206
  square foot addition to an existing one-story automotive repair
  shop, on a site of approximately 9,588 square feet located at 3071
  West Valley Boulevard within the CMU (Commercial Mixed Use)
  zone, and finding Conditional Use Permit CUP-24-02 to be
  exempt from review under the California Environmental Quality
  Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15301, Class 1 of Title 14 of the
  California Code of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review
  projects that are existing facilities.
  •  Assistant Planner Avery Tao provided the Staff presentation.
  •  Juan Duran, the Applicant, was available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon
  2.) Jennifer Ng
  3.) Bert Ng

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 4 with the following added condition
  of approval to: 1.) Limit hours of operation to those listed on their
  application.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Dorado, Seconded by Commissioner
  Gardea.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Mojarro,
  Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None
